newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme holders okay PharmaGenics buy.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme holders okay PharmaGenics buy.

text.p: Genzyme Corp said that its shareholders approved the acquisition of PharmaGenics by Genzyme for about four million shares of a new Genzyme tracking stock, Genzyme Molecular Oncology, in a transaction valued at about $28 million.
This acquisition creates a third tracking stock after Genzyme Corp's division into Genzyme General and Genzyme Tissue Repair.
PharmaGenics, a developer of therapeutic products for cancer through the use of genomics technology, will be part of Genzyme Molecular Oncology, a new Genzyme division.
Genzyme General shareholders will receive about six million shares of this new tracking stock.
Genzyme Molecular Oncology stock will be distributed to Genzyme General and PharmaGenics shareholders after completion of an initial public offering and listing on the Nasdaq National Market.
The distribution to Genzyme General shareholders will be about 12 months following an IPO.
The distribution to PharmaGenics shareholders will be between six and nine 9 months following an IPO.
Genzyme Corp, a biotechnology and health care products company, focuses on developing innovative products and services for major unmet medical needs.
Genzyme General develops and markets pharmaceuticals, genetic diagnostic services, and diagnostic, surgical, and specialty therapeutic products.
Genzyme Tissue Repair is a developer of biological products for the treatment of cartilage damage, severe burns, chronic skin ulcers, and neurodegenerative diseases.
